scope: Layout audit uses computed-style, element-rectangle and layer snapshots only during one synchronous, read-only callback. Each later scroll, viewport or invocation starts fresh; every comparison, threshold and result order remains.

Field multi-view and student-profile layout cases open each view/student once, then resize through all five original profiles. Original readiness assertions still run on every profile, as do all layout, truncation and broken-word assertions.

assertionPreservation.method: TypeScript AST comment-free expression multisets, including expect-rooted matcher chains. Human review separately checks per-profile invocation preservation.

equivalence.qualification: Synthetic static/mutated/scroll/viewport/font fixtures, exact old/new full output equality. No real UI, physical-device or speed acceptance claim.

formattingAfterRun.method: TypeScript ESNext emitted JavaScript with comments removed, then Prettier Babel formatting normalization. Initial raw emit comparison differed only by retained input line breaks; raw byte equality is not claimed.

quick.initialAttempt: Stopped at formatting check; corrected only layout-audit formatting before this passing full quick run.

diagnosticTiming.qualification: Two separate local single-case traced observations, not a back-to-back H1/T1 acceptance measurement. No suite speed gain claimed.
diagnosticTiming.afterRunTooling: Case passed; runner waited for its preview server during shutdown. Root identity-checked and closed only that task server tree. The later full affected-suite run exited normally without manual cleanup.

remaining: The final back-to-back unchanged H1/final T1 idle-machine speed comparison and full verification.
Filed intermittent cold-constructor, crop timing and legacy-page lifecycle defects; a later green run alone does not resolve their cause.
Final required self-review and independent code-quality review.
